welcome.title: Welcome to Expense Tracker
welcome.body: Keep track of your monthly income and expenses. Everything stays on this phone and works offline.

add.title: Add Income & Expenses
add.body: Choose Expense or Income, pick a category, enter the amount and date, then save.

voice.title: Speak Your Expenses
voice.body: Open Voice and speak in Bengali, Hindi or English. You always review the entry before it is saved.

categories.title: Organise with Categories
categories.body: Use the ready-made categories or create your own for income and expenses.

budgets.title: Set Monthly Budgets
budgets.body: Set an overall or per-category limit for the month. You are warned at 80%, 90% and 100%.

reports.title: See Where Money Goes
reports.body: Charts, category breakdown and a monthly calendar show your spending at a glance.

settings.title: Make It Yours
settings.body: Change the language, theme and voice language, and back up or restore your data.

appLock.title: Secure Your App
appLock.body: Lock Expense Tracker with your fingerprint or your phone's screen lock. You can change this later in Settings.
